name: flux_analysis
description: Automated variance (flux) analysis for accounting close. Compares financial periods (Month-over-Month, Quarter-over-Quarter, Year-to-Date), identifies material variances, recommends drill-down dimensions, generates executive commentary with top drivers, and exports to Excel. Triggers: flux analysis, variance analysis, month over month, quarter over quarter, what changed, top drivers, accounting flux, close commentary, variance commentary, run flux, explain the variance.
